body_lead: AI crows, Haaland, Mohanlal: How Kerala Police built a 2-million-strong Instagram community A crow sipping beer before crashing into a tree to warn against drunk driving; Malayalam superstar Mohanlal delivering his iconic line, "Narcotics is a dirty business"; and an AI-generated Erling Haaland reminding Malayalis to wear helmets. This is not the Instagram feed of a content creator. It belongs to the Kerala Police.
